title: The Stalthosian Archipelago — toolkit execution graph
description: Agent-assignable, DAG-gated work to build the Windows-first, engine-neutral research/art/geometry/rigging/validation/benchmark workshop. Planning graph; no tasks are complete by virtue of appearing here.

no_goals: engine choice without measured scene parity
conventions.target: Native Windows, GTX 1080 8 GB + first-gen Ryzen, native 1920x1080, measured 30 FPS full-scene goal; never infer from synthetic workstation.
conventions.agent_policy: Do not edit other task-owned paths, invent API/sources/license rights, claim tests ran without receipts, or mark done without integration review; use isolated branches/worktrees.

lane_descriptions.integration: windows CLI, builds, packaging and release
lane_descriptions.plants: reusable morphology families and species profiles
lane_descriptions.creatures: Smalltrotter shape, rig, animation and stages
lane_descriptions.renderer: Flax/Wicked import, effects and measured comparison

gates.name: Contracts and CLI foundation
gates.review: A real Windows doctor and clean validated fixture command; no optional installers or false success.

gates.name: Reusable asset workshop
gates.review: Six botanical examples and age-distinct Smalltrotter neutral bundle; approved motion/image QA, provenance and deterministic regeneration.

gates.name: Neutral Splitstone and renderer parity
gates.review: Equivalent terrain, plants, rigs, material intent and scripted camera paths in Flax and Wicked.

gates.name: Renderer measured decision
gates.review: Full-scene target-hardware timing and A/B review or explicitly deferred choice with blockers.

tasks.title: Read-only Windows tool doctor
tasks.objective: Inspect actual Windows hardware and available authoring/build tools without installing anything.
steps: Probe OS/CPU/RAM/storage/display/GPU/driver and Git, Python, Blender, C++ SDK, Flax/Wicked, profiling utilities.
Resolve overrideable paths from untracked local config; report optional/missing/incompatible/untested separately.
Emit JSON capabilities and actionable missing-tool messages.
acceptance: PowerShell doctor returns parseable JSON on a Windows host.
Missing optional tools do not fail unrelated probes; no installers or license acceptance.

tasks.title: Versioned toolchain bootstrap
tasks.objective: Reproducibly prepare pinned local Python/orchestration dependencies and record external tool versions.
steps: Provide opt-in venv creation and pinned lock with repeatable installation commands.
Document Blender's separate Python environment and the exact tested external tool versions.
Record local overrides without tracking proprietary binaries or user machine paths.
acceptance: Bootstrap cleanly repeats without clobbering custom installs.
No paid tools, auto-downloads, global package mutations, or implicit license approvals.

tasks.title: Source/artifact/cache layout and safe ignores
tasks.objective: Separate editable source, generated builds, shared caches, published bundles and renderer outputs with bounded local disk use.
steps: Define source/derived/temporary locations and Git LFS guidance with retention/cleanup policy.
Create a non-destructive workspace initializer and dry-run cache pruning.
Exclude third-party installers, licensed references, engine caches and temporary captures from Git.
deliverables: 500 GB SSD and NAS archive staging policy
acceptance: Dry-run cleanup names only regenerable artifacts and never sources or validated published outputs.
Two worktrees can use unique scratch directories without overwriting each other.

tasks.title: Coordinates, IDs, units and seed conventions
tasks.objective: Freeze machine-readable neutral spatial, identity and random-seed conventions before parallel generators.
steps: Specify glTF transforms, meters, up/forward axes, tangent/normal handedness and sRGB/linear material fields.
Define species/form, logical asset, source revision, seeded variant, placed instance and landmark IDs.
Derive stable subseeds with explicit hashing independent of Python runtime random hash.
acceptance: Same profile/seed yields stable IDs across runs/processes.
Unit and axis conversion is testable with a calibrated fixture; no implicit transforms.

tasks.title: Common asset profile JSON Schema
tasks.objective: Declare engine-independent identity, morphology and build inputs under a versioned JSON Schema.
steps: Define common fields, profile kind and schema_version with strict unknown-field policy.
Implement safe YAML ingestion only if chosen; canonical JSON is the validated exchange format.
Create clear field paths and typed validation failures.
acceptance: A malformed ID, missing dimensions or unsupported schema revision fails predictably.
A valid profile validates without Blender or renderer installs.

tasks.title: Provenance and redistribution rights schema
tasks.objective: Preserve reliable licensing and scientific reference traceability for each external asset or reference.
steps: Record canonical source/creator/date/license and separate inspiration-only citations from reused bytes.
Represent PlantFactory/PlantCatalog derived status and redistribution flags explicitly.
Reject publication of undocumented third-party base meshes/textures, not innocent linked citations.
acceptance: Unknown license is not interpreted as CC0 or public domain.
A citation-only documentary image can be referenced without automatically bundling it.

tasks.title: Build, QA and publication receipt contracts
tasks.objective: Describe deterministic inputs, artifact hashes, tool fingerprints, validation, status and run failure without ambiguity.
steps: Record input hashes, seeds, normalized config, tool versions, output paths and SHA-256.
Specify status, warning/error codes, partial-build and publish states.
Differentiate reproducible geometry from driver-dependent render images and measured benchmarks.
acceptance: Receipts from two equivalent normalized inputs compare consistently.
Failed subprocess cannot produce a successful publication receipt.

tasks.title: Plant profile and semantic affordance schema
tasks.objective: Give plant families enough morphology, habitat, browse and bending data without individual biology simulators.
steps: Define woody/frond/segmented/fungus typed forms, growth stages and species-preserving variation ranges.
Describe rootedness, contact bend groups, mouth-accessible foliage zones and wind masks.
Provide concrete Softbough and Royal-frond fixture profiles.
acceptance: Plant variants remain constrained by taxon morphology.
No per-leaf IDs, nutrient conservation or climate history required by schema.

tasks.title: Creature profile, skeleton and interaction schema
tasks.objective: Specify distinct creature stages, bone/IK sockets and visual attachment zones in neutral data.
steps: Define named bones, retarget/follow behavior, clips, morph targets, attachment/contact anchors.
Describe juvenile/adult Smalltrotter proportions, quill/osteoderm zones as fictional design parameters.
Include units/axis and neutral exporters' capability requirements.
acceptance: Missing foot/mouth sockets and invalid bone parents receive specific failures.
Fictional anatomical details are not represented as verified fossil claims.

tasks.title: Terrain, scene and camera-route schemas
tasks.objective: Provide neutral terrain, instance and repeatable benchmark camera/lighting contracts.
steps: Model terrain tiles, non-heightfield meshes, streams, habitats and landmarks.
Store instance IDs, transforms, fixed positions, weather/lighting presets and juvenile-height camera paths.
Require stable random seeds, asset bundle IDs and digestible scene hashes.
acceptance: Camera paths are deterministic and independent of chosen renderer.
No world-scale erosion or general ecological simulator is encoded.

tasks.title: Contract golden fixtures and breaking-change tests
tasks.objective: Ship a reliable set of good and deliberately bad normalized profiles and receipt/scene examples.
steps: Write positive/negative tests for identifiers, units, rights, rig hierarchy, terrain and receipts.
Exercise schema version incompatibility and normalization.
Document migration procedure for future schema changes.
acceptance: Every contract has at least one passing and one meaningfully failing fixture.
No renderer/Blender dependency needed to run golden tests.

tasks.title: PowerShell launcher and Python CLI skeleton
tasks.objective: Expose stable commands for doctor, profile validation and future build/publish actions from Windows.
steps: Implement PS1 launcher and Python module entry point without assuming shell-specific package paths.
Validate arguments and emit clean machine-readable JSON on stdout.
Define exit-code map and support --help with accurate implemented-command status.
acceptance: Unknown commands fail nonzero with actionable error; no fake successful no-op commands.
Windows-first CLI can run schema validation with no Blender installed.

tasks.title: Subprocess adapters and failure envelopes
tasks.objective: Run Blender and other external tools with isolated working directories, timeouts and honest machine receipts.
steps: Implement subprocess runner capturing exit code, stderr logs, duration and version metadata.
Support cancellation, timeout, missing executable and corrupt output cases.
Never mix subprocess chatter into JSON stdout.
acceptance: All nonzero, missing-tool and timeout paths fail with stable codes.
Failure cannot overwrite a previously approved bundle.

tasks.title: Content-addressed build DAG and cache
tasks.objective: Rebuild only invalidated outputs and isolate parallel scratch workspaces.
steps: Hash canonical inputs, generator/tool revisions and external dependencies.
Implement atomic cache publication and reuse for identical tasks.
Handle interrupted runs, corrupted caches and concurrent identical builds.
acceptance: Two workers cannot partially clobber the same cache key.
Changing one texture only invalidates dependent outputs, not unrelated families.

tasks.title: Atomic publish and provenance gate
tasks.objective: Promote only validated, rights-checked immutable asset bundles.
steps: Verify validation receipts, hash graph and licensed source provenance.
Stage content in temporary directory and promote atomically with prior pointer untouched on failure.
Support review status provisional versus art-approved; preserve rejection detail.
acceptance: Bad license/QA blocks publish, leaving prior revision unchanged.
Published bundle hash and source relationship are auditable.

tasks.title: Batch workflow and retry/resume operator
tasks.objective: Allow agents to run whole fixture manifests with bounded concurrency and resumable steps.
steps: Interpret build/preview/validate/publish DAG with explicit prerequisites.
Cap parallel external process count and peak temporary disk budget.
Emit JSONL events and terminal receipt including failed/cached/skipped steps.
acceptance: Retry skips complete verified outputs and reruns only failed/invalidated nodes.
Independent workers cannot race to publish mutable latest outputs.

tasks.title: Windows worker onboarding and command cookbook
tasks.objective: Let a flash-type agent set up and execute a bounded toolkit job from a clean worktree.
steps: Document exact commands as implemented, required/optional prerequisites and no-install default.
Include read-only doctor, schema fixture, deterministic seed and bad-input example.
Explain receipts, artifact paths, LFS and cache pruning.
acceptance: A fresh worker can reproduce a schema fixture with only documented prerequisites.
No instructions claim unavailable commands or benchmark results.

tasks.title: Cross-platform schema CI and Windows smoke CI
tasks.objective: Catch broken contract/CLI changes cheaply without requiring Blender or a dedicated GPU on every PR.
steps: Run stdlib/pinned schema golden tests on public runner and Windows PowerShell smoke.
Report failures as CI, not fictional successful benchmarks.
Keep optional Blender/engine integration in explicitly labeled jobs outside basic gate.
acceptance: Malformed graph or schema causes CI failure.
Core CI requires no paid service, private token or GPU.

tasks.title: Blender background-mode adapter
tasks.objective: Run Blender Python/bpy headlessly with pinned version and export operation receipts.
steps: Probe Blender in background mode; keep bpy interpreter isolation.
Implement deterministic script invocation with explicit input/output JSON paths.
Provide missing-Blender and API-version error handling.
acceptance: A headless Blender fixture succeeds on actual installed Blender.
Missing Blender blocks only relevant asset build, not schema work.

tasks.title: Engine-neutral geometry and glTF/GLB exporter
tasks.objective: Export calibrated source geometry with stable coordinate/units/material naming and semantic sidecars.
steps: Emit static and skinned GLB with source project and sidecar manifests.
Build calibrated 1 m cube, slope-contact and simple skeleton fixtures.
Verify importer-independent bbox, transform, normals and UV metadata.
acceptance: World scale/handedness roundtrip works in a neutral viewer or validator.
No renderer-specific source master required.

tasks.title: Mesh/UV/tangent/interchange validator
tasks.objective: Reject inverted or torn geometry, invalid UVs and broken material/mesh import data.
steps: Check finite geometry, degenerate faces, normals/tangents, UV bounds and nonmanifold exceptions.
Call external Khronos validator when available, with native fallback and explicit coverage notes.
Report actionable diagnostics tied to asset/material/mesh IDs.
acceptance: Deliberate inverted-normal and missing-UV samples fail.
Optional validator absence is reported, never hidden or treated as an authoritative pass.

tasks.title: Rig, animation and morph validation
tasks.objective: Verify skeletal weights, parent graph, required anchors, animations and growth stage exports.
steps: Check cyclic/unknown parents, unweighted vertices and malformed clip durations.
Validate named mouth, feet, tail and neck sockets against creature schema.
Report import format losses rather than dropping animations silently.
acceptance: Wrong bone names, absent sockets or broken weights fail with specific errors.
No assumption that all fauna share one skeleton.

tasks.title: PBR material baking and procedural masks
tasks.objective: Bake/author reusable bark, skin, leaves, rock and fungus materials with correct PBR color space.
steps: Define base-color, normal, roughness, mask, thickness and optional AO passes.
Emit lighting-independent albedo and deterministic bake settings/receipts.
Support neutral calibration swatches and leaf double-sided/transmission intent.
acceptance: Albedo contains no pre-baked directional sun lighting.
Explicit sRGB/linear and tangent-space conventions survive export.

tasks.title: Texture optimization, packing and format adapters
tasks.objective: Optimize texture sizes and mip/alpha behavior without knowingly degrading close-up foliage.
steps: Generate or invoke tested mipmap/packing/compression tool adapters.
Check leaf alpha coverage and normal map conventions for prospective BC5/BC7 outputs.
Keep source textures immutable and compare result images.
acceptance: Output color space and normal orientation are verified.
Unsupported compressor capabilities fall back explicitly rather than pretending success.

tasks.title: LOD, meshoptimizer and impostor candidates
tasks.objective: Generate and validate near/mid/far representations with silhouette and shimmer comparisons.
steps: Integrate meshoptimizer/gltfpack where available and a documented fallback.
Preserve distinct broadleaf/fern/stem treatment rather than blanket alpha-card use.
Emit LOD screen-size metadata and repeatable camera-transition test assets.
acceptance: LOD transitions maintain recognizable silhouettes in moving views.
No arbitrary triangle/texture budget is declared as a substitute for profiling.

tasks.title: Fixed turntable render and material diagnostics
tasks.objective: Produce reproducible neutral/daylight/overcast/wet comparison captures under controlled camera/scale.
steps: Render fixed orthographic and perspective views plus material/normal/roughness diagnostics.
Normalize crop, object scale and filenames across ages/seeds.
Record lighting, Blender version, camera and render hashes.
acceptance: Two variants appear under identical view/lighting conditions.
Driver/render nondeterminism is labeled; same seed geometry determinism remains tested.

tasks.title: Published neutral bundle integration
tasks.objective: Unify editable source, GLB, optimized textures, sockets, LODs and evidence in a verified immutable bundle.
steps: Assemble complete manifest and file hashes with schema-valid sidecars.
Reject missing source, previews, metadata or unreviewed visual state according to gate.
Expose stable bundle lookup for renderer adapters.
acceptance: Bundle can be reconstructed from source/seed/versions and compared by hashes.
Failed validation never appears as an approved published asset.

tasks.title: Reference index, license ledger and rights QA
tasks.objective: Track source photography, fossil and botanical literature, sourced textures and PlantCatalog rights without redistributing unknown materials.
steps: Define a citation-only record vs reusable binary asset distinction.
Add a rights check to asset publish metadata; separate proof levels from fictional design.
Use verified URLs/licenses and record unresolved cases honestly.
acceptance: No downloaded image is called freely redistributable without evidence.
Unknown rights prevent binary reuse, not linked descriptive reference research.

tasks.title: Four-island terrain/photo reference dossiers
tasks.objective: Collect licensed or citation-only photographic landscape sources and concise form/lighting observations for all four islands.
steps: Main: Baraboo/Driftless/Catskills/Highlands/pine barrens/South African variants.
Rainridge: Olympic + Smokies; Stone: Yucatán/Costa Rica cenotes/karst; Outer Reach: Tsingy and badlands.
Tag source credibility, relevant shapes, vegetation/lighting cues and whether redistribution is allowed.
acceptance: Every entry has working canonical link and rights/reuse caution.
These are morphology references, not copied world maps or species claims.

tasks.title: Smalltrotter anatomical evidence and uncertainty dossier
tasks.objective: Separate supported titanosaur anatomy from invented juvenile bristles and island dwarf proportions.
steps: Survey primary/credible scientific sources for dwarf titanosaur, skin, osteoderms and comparative movement.
Document living analogs for age-dependent structures as analogies, not proof.
Supply measured/provisional proportions and close/side/top visual cues for modelers.
acceptance: Every paleontology claim is cited and uncertainty labeled.
Quills are explicitly fictional and remain more prominent in juveniles than adults.

tasks.title: Determinism and artifact provenance tests
tasks.objective: Verify reproducible geometry IDs, stable anchors and rebuild cache semantics independent of image pixel hashes.
steps: Rebuild minimal fixture twice with same config/seed/tool fingerprint.
Compare semantic output fingerprints, geometry bounds, IDs and hashes.
Exercise changed seed, profile and tool-version cache invalidation.
acceptance: No Python-process hash randomness changes geometry identities.
GPU output pixel differences aren't mislabeled geometry nondeterminism.

tasks.title: Silhouette, morphology and biodiversity sheets
tasks.objective: Compare structurally meaningful botanical/animal forms at true scale and consistent view distances.
steps: Build grayscale/solid silhouette contact sheets and leaf/branch anatomy atlases.
Add near/mid/far and multiple age/seed rows.
Flag suspicious visual duplication for human judgment, not automated rejection.
acceptance: Texture recolors alone are not counted as new morphologies.
Different sized specimens are placed at consistent world scale.

tasks.title: Motion/contact/LOD visual review reels
tasks.objective: Review animal gait, foliage wind, plant deflection, LOD shimmer and contact in motion.
steps: Define fixed moving-camera templates and ingest scripted contact animation inputs.
Render side-by-side A/B motion and annotated timing/lighting context.
Separate structural QA from human cinematic-quality review.
acceptance: A moving bad gait or floating foot is visible in evidence.
No still turntable is deemed sufficient to certify motion.

tasks.title: Human art approval and release report
tasks.objective: Require explicit review for anatomy, plant silhouette, material scale and render degradation before production publish.
steps: Record reviewer/date/asset hash/status and reason in canonical receipt.
Report manual visual score separately from numeric performance.
Support request-revision, provisional and accepted states without fake approval.
acceptance: A machine validator cannot self-approve near-photorealistic visual quality.
Optimized versions include comparable before/after captures.

tasks.title: Woody branch/trunk/root procedural core
tasks.objective: Generate editable branch-aware trees/shrubs with root flare, organic joints and botanical parameter controls.
steps: Construct hierarchy-aware trunk/branch meshes and bark UV seams.
Bind leaf/needle placement, stiffness groups, wind masks and variation knobs.
Provide deterministic aged stage outputs and named browsable/interactive groups.
acceptance: Tree is not visibly cylinders joined at right angles.
Identical seed/profile regenerates stable structure and semantic groups.

tasks.title: Splitcrown conifer reference build
tasks.objective: Build irregular tiered crown conifer with true large trunk and root-ground integration.
steps: Author branch whorls and varied crown mass at multiple ages.
Bake plausible bark/needle material and close-up branches.
Export LOD/turntable, roots and simplified trunk collider.
acceptance: Reads as a distinct gymnosperm at juvenile-eye distance.
Stable shape, root flare and nonuniform branching visible in multiple views.

tasks.title: Softbough shrub and bend/browse semantics
tasks.objective: Build visibly compliant branching browse shrub and precise local contact affordances.
steps: Author an arching branch hierarchy with leaves and different growth stages.
Mark bend weights, contact envelopes, accessible foliage and recovery parameters.
Export flexible and static variants to test body passage in renderer.
acceptance: Branch structure is visibly real and not an opaque crossed-card bush.
Local interaction fields can bend/part it without per-leaf physics.

tasks.title: Compound fern and frond procedural core
tasks.objective: Build botanical rachis/pinna morphology families and age-varied fronds without flat generic cards.
steps: Parameterize basal crown, rachis curvature, pinna rows/leaflets, taper and stiffness.
Support whole frond/dead variant and simplified distant equivalent.
Record leaf and branch material/UV/wind groups.
acceptance: Closeup visibly shows a rachis and distinct pinnae.
Supports at least two different species architectures beyond recoloring.

tasks.title: Royal frond reference build
tasks.objective: Produce fine-leaflet moist woodland fern with graceful frond arches and juveniles.
steps: Tune pinna shape/spacing, frond angles and age spread.
Author material/underside detail and damp/wind appearance.
Export neutral/reduced variants and neutral+forest previews.
acceptance: Reads as a recognizable fern rather than crossed leaf cards.
Different young/adult silhouettes share lineage-specific anatomy.

tasks.title: Basketfern giant frond reference build
tasks.objective: Produce a dramatically distinct tall humid-hollow fern architecture.
steps: Build robust crown/rhachis and large compound fronds.
Add realistic asymmetry, litter/dead fronds and surface masks.
Export several seed variants and low-camera scale sheet.
acceptance: A silhouette sheet clearly distinguishes Basketfern from Royal frond.
The giant frond is believable and not merely a scaled Royal-frond clone.

tasks.title: Jointed-stem/horsetail procedural core
tasks.objective: Generate segmented upright stems, nodes and branch whorls as dense plausible colonies.
steps: Model variable nodes/internodes, alternate/whorl branches and growth stages.
Support clump placement, packed distance LOD, bending/wind masks.
Prevent rigid grid, repeated vertical tube appearance.
acceptance: Joints and branch whorls remain visible in close views.
Large patches avoid uniform repeated geometry.

tasks.title: Jointreed wet-thicket reference build
tasks.objective: Build segmented wet thickets at juvenile eye level, suitable for browsing and local push-through.
steps: Tune stem clustering, mature height, branch whorls and translucency.
Define edible shoot areas and contact proxies.
Export dense near and optimized far stand fixtures.
acceptance: Recognizable segmented reed/horsetail structure, not plain grass strips.
Wind/contact groups and browse geometry survive export.

tasks.title: Attached bracket fungus and decomposing log
tasks.objective: Create convincing substrate-attached bracket fungus on fallen wood without a nutrient simulator.
steps: Generate log/substrate anchor with moss/litter-compatible interface.
Model layered fungus shelves and wet/old material variants.
Export neutral package and overcast closeups.
acceptance: No floating shelves or repetitive cookie-cutter spacing.
Asset bundle flags fungus as decorative unless interactable tags specified.

tasks.title: Plant morphology variation and seed-family guardrails
tasks.objective: Produce varied but identifiable members of a fictional plant form, with stable appearance seeds.
steps: Implement domain-specific parameter ranges across woody, fern and jointed families.
Generate silhouette sheet against fixed camera/equal height.
Check duplicate shape signatures and stable named anchors.
acceptance: Different seeds vary shape but preserve species/family architecture.
No color-only changes counted as morphological diversity.

tasks.title: Six reference plants reproducible batch
tasks.objective: Prove the complete plant workshop on all six original reference specimens.
steps: Create stable profile/seed/stage manifest and batch generation.
Validate, render visual sheets and report failing assets without publishing partial results.
Deliver independently editable masters and engine-neutral bundles.
acceptance: All six are structurally identifiable and pass schema/export/QA.
A clean documented command reproduces outputs on prepared Windows workstation.

tasks.title: Smalltrotter neutral rig and attachments
tasks.objective: Create anatomically plausible named skeleton and skin/IK contact contract for Smalltrotter.
steps: Author axial, neck, tail, hip, limbs, jaw, eye/ear and contact bones.
Create stable mouth/foot/water and posture anchors independent of engine.
Add skeleton hierarchy validation and exported bind pose.
acceptance: All four foot contacts and browsing mouth location validate.
Engine-neutral skeleton does not contain Flax/Wicked-only identifiers.

tasks.title: Smalltrotter juvenile/adult anatomical masters
tasks.objective: Produce anatomically designed dwarf titanosaur masters with genuine juvenile-to-adult body shape differences.
steps: Shape torso, posture, head/neck/tail proportions with evidence labels.
Author skin fold/morph or stage meshes bound to shared rig.
Create close, side, top silhouette and root-foot-ground reviews.
acceptance: Clearly reads as dwarf titanosaur, not elongated generic reptile.
Adult bulk, joints and head/neck proportions differ from juvenile.

tasks.title: Bristles, osteoderms and skin materials
tasks.objective: Implement stage-varying quill silhouette and scaled skin/armor without claiming fossil proof.
steps: Attach sparse quill-like juvenile nape/shoulder bristles to stage/risk zones.
Reduce visible bristles and increase scattered osteoderm/skin wrinkle detail with age.
Bake microtexture with believable anatomical folds, roughness and wear.
acceptance: Juvenile nape shaggy but not woolly/porcupine; adult sparsely bristled.
Quill hypothesis labeled fictional in appearance documentation.

tasks.title: Walk, stand, rest and turn animation set
tasks.objective: Author skeletal gait and weight/inertia-aware basic motion suitable for runtime import tests.
steps: Animate locomotion phases and foot contacts with stable clip naming.
Include turn, idle gaze/breathing, rest-to-stand and slope/ground adaptations.
Record IK/contact cues for engine adapter tests.
acceptance: Feet do not visibly skate through ground in reference playback.
Age stages preserve motion and bone attachment while showing mass differences.

tasks.title: Browse, drink, head/neck and contact clips
tasks.objective: Provide plausible mouth-to-plant/drinking reach and adjacent plant bend trigger fixtures.
steps: Create feeding/drinking neck/head motion under real target distances.
Emit mouth contact events and brief pause/recover transitions.
Supply scripted Softbough pass-through and foliage bite test clips.
acceptance: Mouth visibly reaches valid targets; browsing state can be consumed once.
Camera motion alone never triggers plant contact.

tasks.title: Creature growth stages, rig import and QA batch
tasks.objective: Round-trip Smalltrotter juvenile/adult rig, materials, LODs and clips into published neutral bundle.
steps: Build both stages under pinned seed and tool fingerprints.
Run geometry, rig/socket/animation QA and turntable/motion evidence.
Publish candidate only with rights and explicit visual review.
acceptance: Stages, socket placement, integument and clips survive export.
Failure in one stage doesn't promote an incomplete two-stage bundle.

tasks.title: Neutral terrain representations and scene fragments
tasks.objective: Choose offline-compatible heightfield plus local 3D rock overlay semantics for Splitstone.
steps: Document tile dimensions, terrain material masks and coordinate conversion.
Support real 3D cliff/arch undercuts and collision proxy overlays.
Treat drainage and geology as composition inputs rather than historical solvers.
acceptance: Heightfield and rock meshes align with no major gaps.
No runtime erosion, aquifer or volume-fluid system required.

tasks.title: Splitstone ravine/stream/valley terrain source
tasks.objective: Author detailed animal-scale ravine, descending stream, sheltered hollow and open valley.
steps: Use deliberate offline layering/procedural composition to form traversable 1 km landscape.
Include a dense renderer comparison patch around 512x512 m.
Validate downhill stream and plausible animal routes, with some inaccessible rock.
acceptance: Stream consistently descends; bluff/hollow/ordinary intervals visually read.
A juvenile creature can explore realistic alternate routes; not all slopes are passable.

tasks.title: Local cliffs, boulders, rock interfaces and collision
tasks.objective: Create plausible rock ribs, caprock remnant, crevices and true overhang meshes with terrain seams.
steps: Generate or author cliff/undercut geometry beyond heightfield limitations.
Build collision proxies, rock/ground blend masks and rooted crevice anchor zones.
Check scaled juvenile/large-beast passability and foot clipping.
acceptance: No prominent floating boulders or terrain/mesh cracks.
Undercuts actually exist as 3D geometry and preserve collisions.

tasks.title: Streams, wetness and habitat suitability data
tasks.objective: Generate map-side water surfaces and cheap moisture/sun/substrate habitat input fields.
steps: Encode stream direction, banks and flood/wetness masks as precomputed fields.
Derive forest/sun/shade/rock seep/wetland placement guidance.
Export traceable masks and deterministic checks.
acceptance: Water direction agrees with elevation and bank orientation.
Masks are static inputs; no runtime groundwater/erosion simulation.

tasks.title: Fixed animal-scale camera and weather test routes
tasks.objective: Provide exact repeatable juvenile-height routes that stress foliage, reveal and streaming.
steps: Author forward travel, rapid turns, rock-bank approach, stream crossing, detached near-hill reveal and storm comparison.
Record frame positions, camera orientation and weather time in neutral route manifest.
Include high and low occlusion intervals and deliberate near-far tree passes.
acceptance: Identical route sampled in both engines yields same world camera parameters.
Occluding ridge reveal tests wildlife/foliage readiness separately from frustum.

tasks.title: Instance population using habitat masks and stable seeds
tasks.objective: Compose a believable, dense plant/rock community in shared neutral scene without scene-specific hand edits per engine.
steps: Place common canopy/understory and rare forms with stable IDs and multi-scale clustering.
Use wet/shade/soil/rock mask relationships and material/height constraints.
Emit density, rendered coverage and seed/instance manifest.
acceptance: Different engines import identical source transforms and coverage.
No all-forms-everywhere random scatter or obvious grid repetition.

tasks.title: Neutral Splitstone full benchmark scene package
tasks.objective: Assemble reproducible terrain/rock/foliage/water/animal test environment independent of renderer.
steps: Resolve published assets and animated creature into scene package.
Include material intent, lighting modes, weather states, camera routes and activation stress fixtures.
Validate source manifests, hashes, collisions and completeness.
acceptance: Flax and Wicked receive exactly the same source scene/geometry/placement inputs.
No missing content silently omitted by benchmark runner.

tasks.title: Flax import/build adapter for neutral bundles
tasks.objective: Script reproducible Flax import and standalone build from asset/scene manifest without editing authored masters.
steps: Pin tested Flax revision/editor CLI and importer mappings.
Translate neutral bundles to Flax terrain, foliage, rigs and materials.
Produce import capability/feature-loss report and a scripted camera fixture.
acceptance: One neutral unit/rig/leaf fixture imports with correct dimensions and animations.
Unsupported engine features are reported, not omitted silently.

tasks.title: Wicked import/build adapter for neutral bundles
tasks.objective: Script reproducible Wicked Engine import and standalone build from the same source manifest.
steps: Pin tested Wicked revision and Windows compiler/build prerequisites.
Convert glTF and neutral terrain/scene descriptions into derived Wicked project assets.
Report camera, rig, material and alpha/wind feature mapping issues.
acceptance: One neutral calibrated fixture imports with right units and animation.
Renderer-specific WISCENE/cooked formats are derived and never canonical source.

tasks.title: Equal-scene parity audit for two renderers
tasks.objective: Prevent a renderer from winning performance by silently reducing instances, shadow quality, lighting or content.
steps: Record asset IDs, visible coverage, camera path, sun/wet presets and import losses.
Compare semantic fidelity and automated view/capture labels.
Require human art review of visually equivalent fidelity, not pixel-identical APIs.
acceptance: Both test scenes have equivalent plant coverage and creature animation.
Any tradeoff/missing feature appears in comparison report before timing conclusions.

tasks.title: Local shader-driven shrub contact prototypes
tasks.objective: Test local wind+animal contact bending rather than uncontrolled shrub clipping.
steps: Implement bounded contact capsules/deformation fields against a no-contact baseline.
Prototype renderer-appropriate vertex deformation and optional branch-bone variant.
Capture moving pass-through and recovery with actual CPU/GPU timing.
acceptance: Branches/ferns visibly part and recover around creature body.
No per-leaf physics, no camera-only trigger, no unmeasured compromise.

tasks.title: Windows repeatable performance capture harness
tasks.objective: Run repeatable native 1080p standalone builds and collect raw frame/hitch/hardware traces.
steps: Wrap PresentMon where supported; capture clocks, GPU busy, P50/P95/P99, 1% lows, VRAM and CPU render data.
Preserve cold vs warm stream runs, driver, API, binary hash and 3+ route repeats.
Gracefully mark profiler features unavailable on Pascal rather than fabricating counters.
acceptance: Logs show below-30 FPS events, spikes and streaming hitches.
When no reference hardware is connected, result is blocked/unmeasured.

tasks.title: V1–V4 foliage geometry, overdraw and LOD trials
tasks.objective: Compare equivalent plant silhouettes and coverage for mesh/card geometry, wind-free foliage, shadows and LOD changes.
steps: Run native-instancing, broadleaf vs pinna vs thin-stem variants and geometry-vs-alpha coverage tests.
Measure GPU busy, overdraw, draw submission, VRAM and shimmer.
Pair raw timings with moving camera A/B and honest visual parity notes.
acceptance: No cheaper rendering representation is declared better solely on triangle count.
Dense vegetation comparisons use matching coverage and camera paths.

tasks.title: V5–V8 wind, light, water and animated creature trials
tasks.objective: Measure sun/ambient/transmission, wind/contact, water/wetness and creature skinning against visual goals.
steps: Run wind hierarchy, local bending, shadows/foliage transmission and weather/wet materials.
Profile Smalltrotter skinning/IK and authored waterbank appearance.
Capture repeated route differences with FPS/VRAM and look-quality comparisons.
acceptance: Dense woodland close views remain plausible in shade/wetness and contact.
Regressions recorded; 30 FPS not assumed.

tasks.title: V9–V10 appearance/streaming continuity stress tests
tasks.objective: Validate cached scenery and pre-staged fauna before camera reveal without implementing deep live ecology.
steps: Mock identity-preserving prepared animals beyond full detached-camera tether.
Run fast chunk crossing/reload and short hill revisit against seeded trees and sparse damage overrides.
Time activation/upload spikes and check visible pop/known-animal duplication.
acceptance: Camera frustum alone never causes wildlife to materialize in view.
No full-world hidden biology polling or historical weather replay.

tasks.title: Measured engine selection recommendation
tasks.objective: Choose Flax/Wicked on measured reference scenes and integration cost, or explain why evidence is insufficient.
steps: Compare full-scene 1080p P99 <=33.3 ms provisional gate plus other CPU/GPU/VRAM/quality data.
Document software/build/asset workflow burden, shader control and scene parity.
If neither meets targets, identify specific optimization experiments and retain decision as open.
acceptance: Recommendation includes A/B images/motion and real timed data.
No unmeasured winner or blanket quality sacrifice.

tasks.title: End-to-end toolkit handoff and release audit
tasks.objective: Make workshop reproducible by a fresh agent including failures, QA, asset provenance and engine-neutral publication.
steps: Replay first-time bootstrap/profile/generation/QA/preview/publish on prepared Windows machine.
Validate fresh worktree, corrupted input, license rejection, missing optional dependencies and hash repeatability.
Record operator instructions, known limits, storage footprint and unfinished benchmarks.
acceptance: New worker can generate the six plants and proxy via documented commands.
No unsupported claim that the final game or the complete biodiversity catalog exists.
